outcome: A fixed affine calibration trained from fully nested predictions improved all three development partitions.

audit.physical_effect_signs: No fixed negative porosity coefficient or rule that heterogeneous grains mean low hardness remains in the current learned estimators. Tree monotonic constraints are None; Ridge positive constraints are False; nonlinear kernel and neural heads are unconstrained.
audit.orientation: Alignment uses the magnitude of the doubled-angle resultant. CNN D4 training imposes an orientation-invariance assumption on its 0.1875 ensemble contribution; S/B frozen descriptors use no D4 averaging or training augmentation. No global D4-invariance claim or repeated D4 trial.
audit.physical_scale: Pixel diameters and inverse-square-root transforms are proxies with learned relationships. No micrometre conversion or fixed physical coefficient.
audit.target_range: No target/output clipping in 008. Feature clipping in legacy train-fit MinMax scalers can limit extrapolation.
audit.official_pdf_access: Parent supplied official cautions; direct URL retrieval failed. The audit checks the supplied cautions against local code, without claiming independent retrieval of the PDF.
audit.proxy_residual_evidence: Porosity, grain-size heterogeneity and alignment proxies had weak signed-residual Spearman associations, at most about 0.073 in absolute value. These do not justify sign constraints or another D4 trial.

calibration_diagnosis.target_tail_warning: Residuals contain the observed target, so residual-versus-target or target-tail bias alone does not establish correctable shrinkage. The actionable diagnostic uses prediction-conditioned residuals.
calibration_diagnosis.loss_interpretation: S/B standalone slopes were below one while final-ensemble slopes were above one. This supports testing ensemble calibration, not claiming that SmoothL1 alone caused underdispersion. Prior 058 already tested and rejected a loss replacement.

procedure.calibrator: Unconstrained OLS intercept and slope on 320 fresh inner OOF prediction/target pairs. No strength, bin, spline, weight or clipping search.
procedure.inner_models: Every baseline, kernel, CNN and S/B head is fit inside the current outer training set. Kernel hyperparameters use a further training-only CV level.
procedure.no_global_oof_training: Historical global OOF values are only the unchanged outer-validation predictions and baseline. They never train the calibrator.
procedure.generalization_risk: Calibration pairs come from smaller fitted models than those receiving the correction. This training-size mismatch is evaluated as part of the fixed procedure.

limits: Development-only split robustness, not independent validation. All 400 rows informed historical feature/model/recipe choices. Kernel inner CV controls only current bandwidth/alpha choices. Exact/D4 groups do not verify source family independence. Conditional bootstrap omits fitting/selection uncertainty; the two partitions reuse the same observations. No holdout evaluation.
The diagnostic led to this experiment after many prior studies on the same 400 rows. Three partitions are split-robustness checks, not independent validation.
Conditional bootstrap intervals omit fitting and adaptive-selection uncertainty. No claim of statistically proven improvement or prize readiness.
Candidate009, if present, is unsubmitted. Its Public/private performance is unknown.
